items.title: Koamas at the Tavelli event
items.summary: Koamas will be presenting the citizen-science sighting network and the first season of verified records. Full details are being finalised — check back shortly.

items.title: Koamas at the MMRI symposium
items.summary: Koamas presented the WhatsApp-based sighting network at the MMRI symposium, setting out how citizen reports are verified and turned into an open record of Maldivian cetaceans.
